intent: Move Mount planner into Design tools (docs/specs/lab/workbench/spec.md), separate selecting from moving, and let designers select and deliberately drag an existing linked-slot crossbar by its midpoint. Crossbar offsets are signed half units from the ship origin along ship-local X, with no change to mount geometry or fitting coupling. The Mount planner spec also defines undo and draft handoff, including legacy imports.
result: Observed in the working tree based on 47c68fe6: apps/web/src/data/lab-pages.ts puts Mount planner in Design tools for the Tray and index. apps/web/src/components/lab/mount-planner/MountPlanner.svelte implements select-first mount and crossbar editing. packages/mode-a/src/lib/mount-planner.ts validates and exports v2 with baseline and draft routing, and handles legacy imports. packages/mode-a/src/lib/build-renderer.ts shares crossbar paths with the planner while keeping the catalog default for production consumers.
verification: Observed locator and current-link assertions against local preview HTML for the Lab index and Mount planner after the navigation change. Inspected committed-test candidates: packages/mode-a/src/lib/mount-planner.test.ts covers half-unit validation, route geometry, drift and migration; tests/browser/mount-planner.spec.ts covers keyboard routing handoff and stale legacy preservation. Delivery workers reported successful targeted checks and Chromium mouse, keyboard and emulated-touch runs at supported widths. Those temporary gesture runs were not retained as repeatable tests. Physical touch, Safari and deployment were not verified.

findings.summary: Retained browser coverage does not exercise the select-first canvas gestures. This is a coverage limitation, not evidence that the gestures fail.

evidence.supports: The retained tests edit through fields and controls, not through a pointer gesture on a mount or a crossbar midpoint.
Delivery workers reported passing Chromium gesture checks for mouse and emulated touch against these behaviors; no durable transcript was retained.
